register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Stream YT Music with crossfade, an equalizer and control from any device.

checkEmail.title: Check your inbox
checkEmail.body: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it on any device to activate your account.
checkEmail.resent: Sent. It can take a minute to arrive.

verify.title: Confirming your email…
verify.failed: This link is invalid or has expired.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses that email, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password changed. Sign in with your new password.

strength.label: Strength
strength.required: Use a longer passphrase or mix in unrelated words.

google.title: Google account
google.body: Link your Google account so Lyra can use YT Music like the official app.

listening.title: What you listen to
listening.historyHint: Songs you play for at least 30 seconds are added to your history, so YouTube Music can tune your home page and recommendations.
listening.historyNeedsGoogle: Link your Google account to use it.
listening.public: Show what I listen to publicly
listening.publicHint: Creates a card with your current (or last) song for your GitHub or website. Anyone with the link can see it.
listening.widgetAlt: What I am listening to on Lyra
listening.cacheNote: GitHub caches images for a while, so the card may take a few minutes to change.

password.title: Password
password.done: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.body: Sign in with your fingerprint, face or screen lock instead of a password.

sessions.title: Where you're signed in
sessions.revokeOthers: Sign out of all other devices

tokens.title: Personal tokens
tokens.body: Let other apps (a Discord plugin, a script) see what you are listening to. Treat them like a password.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.createdOnce: Copy your token now: you will not see it again.
tokens.events: To hear about every change right away, without asking every few seconds, connect to {{path}} (Server-Sent Events).

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: Deletes your Lyra account, sessions, passkeys and Google link, plus the downloads on this device. Your YT Music library is not touched.
delete.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. Enter your password to confirm.

about.title: About Lyra
about.available: A new version is out: {{version}}, published on {{date}}.

errors.email_not_verified: Confirm your email before signing in.
errors.email_taken: An account already uses this email.
errors.disposable_email: Use a permanent email address, not a disposable one.
errors.weak_password: That password is too easy to guess.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.unauthorized: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.too_many_requests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.passkey_failed: The passkey could not be used. Try again.
errors.invalid_image: That file is not an image we can use.
errors.network: Can't reach Lyra. Check your connection.
errors.google_not_linked: Link your Google account in your profile to see this.
errors.google_session_expired: Your Google session expired. Link the account again from your profile.
errors.upstream: YT Music didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
errors.invalid_cookies: Those cookies don't contain a signed-in YouTube session.
errors.not_signed_in: Google didn't finish signing in. Try again.
errors.browser_unavailable: The sign-in browser couldn't start on the server.
errors.browser_busy: Another sign-in is in progress. Try again in a minute.
errors.registration_closed: New accounts are closed on this Lyra.
errors.too_many_tokens: You already have the most tokens allowed. Revoke one to create another.
errors.account_suspended: Your account is suspended. Talk to whoever runs this server.
errors.protected_account: You cannot do that to your own account or another admin's.

music.linkToSeeLibrary: Link Google to see your playlists.

browser.title: Sign in with Google
browser.body: A secure browser runs on your Lyra server. Sign in as you would on YouTube; Lyra keeps only the session.
browser.disconnected: The connection to the sign-in browser was lost.

cookies.title: Paste cookies
cookies.body: On a computer, open music.youtube.com signed in, open DevTools → Network, click any request to music.youtube.com and copy the whole “cookie” request header.
cookies.label: Cookie header

settings.title: Audio settings
settings.autoplay: Keep playing similar songs when the queue ends
settings.dataSaverHint: Uses these qualities on mobile data or with the browser's data saver.
settings.onMobileData: You are on mobile data now.

googleRequired.title: Link your Google account
googleRequired.notLinked: This server can only play songs with a linked Google account, because YouTube blocks anonymous requests coming from it. Link it from your profile: Lyra keeps only the session.
googleRequired.expired: Your Google session expired and YouTube no longer plays with it. Link your account again from your profile.

library.name: Name
library.deleteConfirm: Delete “{{title}}”? This also deletes it on YT Music.
library.needsGoogle: Link Google in your profile to use your library.

connect.title: Listening on
connect.subtitle: Control playback on any of your devices

video.notFound: No music video found for this song.

offline.title: Downloads
offline.empty: Songs you download play without a connection. Use “Download” on any song, album or playlist.
offline.banner: You’re offline. Your downloads still play.
offline.failed: Some songs could not be downloaded.
offline.installHint: Add Lyra to your home screen for a full-screen app.

states.notFoundBody: This link does not lead anywhere in Lyra.
states.crashBody: Lyra hit an unexpected error on this page.

users.suspendConfirm: Suspend {{name}}? Their sessions end and they cannot sign in until you restore them.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}'s account? Everything is erased and it cannot be undone.

announcements.placeholder: E.g. Tonight at 22:00 Lyra restarts for a few minutes.
